titulo: A bookmark instead of the folded corner
caption:
A bookmark instead of the folded corner

She stops mid-fold, finds a bookmark in the drawer and uses it. The corner stays flat.

A bookmark is ten seconds to find, and a folded page is permanent.

For whoever finds a bookmark instead of folding the corner.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom with a thick blue book standing on the right and an ink-black block figure with white eyes at the left, trembling with narrowed eyes. Its eyes go wide, it walks to the book, the book opens and a page turns. A small orange bookmark pops up from between the pages and its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me, folding the corner is fine, to: found a bookmark. page is flat.
